newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end weaker ahead of U.S. elections.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end weaker ahead of U.S. elections.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed lower on Tuesday, after languishing in negative territory for most of the day. Trading was spiritless ahead of the U.S. elections and the launch of a new Japanese government and the formation of its policies, brokers said.
The key Nikkei 225 average fell 40.73 points or 0.20 percent to 20,592.33. Its December futures dipped 20 points to 20,620.
"Investors simply wanted to wait and see the outcome of the elections in the United States," said Tetsuya Ishijima, chief strategist at Okasan Securities Co Ltd.
